noNpcs: There is no one to speak with here.

delivery.exchanged: Exchange completed once. Give {{output}} to its recipient to continue the quest.
delivery.exchange: Giving consumes {{item}} and gives you {{output}}. Claim the quest reward separately after completing the remaining deliveries.
delivery.consumes: Giving consumes {{item}}. Claim the quest reward separately in Quests.
delivery.unavailable: Track the quest, complete its earlier objectives, and recover this item first.
delivery.consumed: Delivered. This item can only be given once. Claim the quest reward separately in Quests.

dialogue.legacyAnya: Anya is present from an older completed quest. This history does not grant new quest rewards or thaw proof.

act1.cain: Thank you for freeing me. Let us uncover what the darkness conceals.

act5.larzuk: Track Siege on Harrogath before facing Shenk in the Bloody Foothills. After claiming the reward, bring an eligible unsocketed backpack item here to use your socket charge.
act5.malah: Inspect frozen Anya in the Crystalline Passage, then return here for my potion. Take it back to thaw her before confronting Nihlathak. Claim your Scroll of Resistance in Quests and read it in Inventory.
act5.qual-kehk: Clear the Frigid Highlands and release all three groups of prisoners. In the Ancients’ Way, defeat Talic, Korlic and Madawc together to complete their rite.
act5.anya: Thank you for freeing me. Your main Scroll of Resistance must be claimed in Quests, then read in Inventory. My separate Gift grants direct +10 resistance to all six damage channels and another personalization charge when you Claim it in Quests. After that, each of my two named trades costs 40 scrap and 2000 Rune Shards, once per character.
act5.cain: Anya and Nihlathak are in the Crystalline Passage. The Ancients await in the Ancients’ Way. Follow your tracked quests and claim each reward separately.
act5.tyrael: In the Throne of Destruction, overcome the five minion waves in order, then defeat Baal. Claim Eve of Destruction to select your title and unlock Nightmare replay.

greetings.cain: Bring me the Jade Figurine from the Spider Forest, and I will exchange it for the Golden Bird. Alkor may know its purpose.
greetings.hratli: The Gidbinn once protected Kurast. Recover it in the Flayer Jungle, then give it to Ormus.
greetings.ormus: Bring Ormus the Gidbinn, and its sacred power may shelter this dock once more.
greetings.alkor: Bring me the Golden Bird, or recover Lam Esen’s Tome in Kurast Bazaar and give it to me. When the bird is delivered, claim the Potion of Life in Quests and read it in Inventory.
greetings.asheara: The Iron Wolves keep watch over these docks. Beyond them, the jungle offers little shelter.
greetings.meshif: I brought you to Kurast. Take care beyond the docks; the jungle has changed.
greetings.akara: I am Akara. Darkness presses on the camp, and we need your help.
greetings.charsi: I'm Charsi, the camp's blacksmith. While the hammer rings, hope holds.
greetings.gheed: Gheed, at your service. I see value where others see scraps. Recover my five marked lots in the Cold Plains, then Claim your payment in Quests.
greetings.kashya: I am Kashya, captain of the Rogue archers. Darkness has taken many sisters, but we still hold this camp.
greetings.warriv: I am Warriv, leader of this caravan. The roads are dangerous, so we remain here for now.
greetings.atma: Radament's lair is a burial chamber beneath the Far Oasis. Track Radament's Lair in Quests. Once you defeat him, claim your reward there and read the Book of Skill in Inventory.

act4.cain: Track Hell’s Forge before confronting Hephasto in the River of Flame. Recover his hammer, then use it with Mephisto’s Soulstone at the Hellforge. Both are consumed; claim the quest reward separately.
act4.halbu: I am Halbu. These walls offer a brief refuge from the River of Flame. Prepare yourself before returning to battle.
act4.jamella: The Pandemonium Fortress is a small light against the darkness. Rest here, then choose your next battle carefully.
act4.tyrael: Track The Fallen Angel before facing Izual on the Plains of Despair. In the Chaos Sanctuary, open the three seals in order, then defeat Diablo for Terror’s End quest credit. Claim each reward in Quests.

greetings.drognan: A change of discipline may reveal another path. I can help you recover the points you have invested.

act2.greiz: After you complete Radament’s Lair, a hero of level 12 or higher may enlist a Blessed Aim mercenary here in Normal. Choose a companion and confirm Enlist; claim Greiz’s Roster separately in your quest journal.
act2.fara: After completing Radament's Lair, speak with me here in Lut Gholein. Claim 1 gem-shard separately in Quests. Gem fusion still requires your own 3 matching gems of the same type and quality.

den.untracked: Demons infest the Den of Evil near camp. Track the Den of Evil in Quests, then clear the cave.
den.preclear: Demons remain in the Den of Evil. Slay them all, then return to me.
den.readyToClaim: You have cleansed the Den of Evil and given the camp some peace. Claim your reward in Quests.
den.claimed: The darkness in the Den of Evil has lifted. May your new strength guard the camp.

description.socket_item: Spend one charge to add sockets to one eligible unsocketed weapon or armor in your backpack. The selected item is changed permanently.
description.socket_armor: Spend one charge to add sockets to one eligible unsocketed armor item in your backpack. The selected item is changed permanently.
description.personalize_item: Spend one charge to mark one eligible backpack item with your character’s current name. This adds no combat stats.

services.consumed: Charge used. This reward cannot be spent again.
services.noCandidates: No eligible backpack items. Bring an eligible unequipped item into your backpack.

feedback.already-consumed: This charge or action has already been used.
feedback.not-eligible: This item or character is not eligible.
feedback.not-ready: Save data is loading. Try again shortly.
feedback.no-player: Create or load a character first.
feedback.combat-active: Finish or stop combat before continuing.
feedback.claim-in-progress: Another quest action is still finishing. Try again shortly.
feedback.grant-failed: The action could not finish. Nothing was spent; try again.
feedback.busy: A combat or quest update is still finishing. Try again shortly.
feedback.restoration-failed: The action could not be restored. Stop here and reload your last saved game.
feedback.not-owned: Claim the required quest reward first.
feedback.already-available: This reward’s charge is already available.

titles.title: Character title
titles.description: Choose a title for your nameplate. Titles add no combat stats.

respec.title: Reset your build
respec.policy: Stats and skills each have {{free}} free resets. Further resets cost {{cost}} wishstones.

refund.stat_one: Refund {{count}} stat point. Equipment and learned skills stay equipped.
refund.stat_other: Refund {{count}} stat points. Equipment and learned skills stay equipped.
refund.skill_one: Refund {{count}} skill point. Learned skills, priority and selected aura will be cleared.
refund.skill_other: Refund {{count}} skill points. Learned skills, priority and selected aura will be cleared.

respec.freeConfirmation: This uses one free reset of this kind.
respec.noHealing: Life and Mana are preserved, clamped if their maximum decreases.

feedback.ok: Points refunded. Choose your new build in Character or Skills.
feedback.no-player: Create or continue a character first.
feedback.wrong-town: Visit the reset NPC in your current unlocked town.
feedback.not-ready: Wait for the save to finish loading.
feedback.combat-active: Finish or leave the current run before resetting.
feedback.stale: Your character, balance or town changed. Review a fresh reset.
feedback.grant-failed: The reset failed and your points and payment were restored.
feedback.no-allocations: There are no allocated points of this kind to refund.
feedback.invalid-player: This character has invalid allocation or reset data.
feedback.insufficient-wishstones: You need more wishstones for this reset.
feedback.busy: Wait for the current action to finish.
feedback.restoration-failed: State recovery failed. Reload your last saved character before continuing.

identify.title: Identify an item
identify.description: Permanently unlocked. Identify one selected backpack item for free.
identify.noCandidates: No unidentified backpack equipment is available.

imbue.title: Charsi’s Imbue
imbue.description: Each earned reward imbues one selected item into rare gear. The item keeps its base and identity. Each charge is spent once.
imbue.presentDescription: Show Charsi an identified normal weapon or armor with no sockets. It stays in your backpack unchanged. Claim the side quest reward separately in Quests.
imbue.presentSuccess: Item presented unchanged. Claim Charsi’s Imbue in Quests to earn its separate charge.
imbue.noCandidates: Bring an identified, unequipped normal weapon or armor with no sockets or affixes into your backpack.
imbue.mainReward: Tools of the Trade · main reward
imbue.restorable: Previously claimed reward. Restore its missing charge here.
imbue.restoreSuccess: This reward’s charge is available. Select an item to use it.
imbue.useSuccess: Selected item imbued. This charge has been used.

larzukPresent.title: Larzuk’s Socketing Favor
larzukPresent.description: After defeating Shenk, present eligible unsocketed backpack gear. The item stays unchanged. Claim the side-quest socket charge in your journal, then choose gear here to add sockets.
larzukPresent.success: Item presented unchanged. Claim your socket charge in the quest journal, then return here to choose gear for socketing.

warband.title: Qual-Kehk’s Warband
warband.description: After freeing all three prisoner groups, a hero of level 35 or higher can enlist at Qual-Kehk in Normal difficulty. Choose a recruit, then confirm for free. Claim the quest reward separately in your journal.
warband.freshDescription: Enlist adds this recruit to your roster and fields him.
warband.retainedDescription: Re-enlist fields this exact recruit, keeping his equipment, experience and current condition.
warband.success: Recruit enlisted and fielded. Claim Qual-Kehk’s Warband separately in your quest journal. The one-time reward keeps an owned recruit or provides one if dismissed before Claim, while preserving your fielded choice.

enlistment.description: Choose a companion and explicitly confirm Enlist or Re-enlist. Claim this quest separately in your journal. Its one-time reward keeps an owned companion or provides one if dismissed before Claim, preserving your fielded choice.

requirements.kashya: Defeat Blood Raven, then return to Kashya. Enlist here in Normal difficulty. The main quest reward need not be claimed.
requirements.greiz: Complete Radament’s Lair and reach hero level 12. Enlist here in Normal difficulty; Claim and reading the Book of Skill are not required.
requirements.asheara: Unlock Act III and reach hero level 18. Enlist here in Normal difficulty.

enlistment.freshDescription: Enlist adds this companion to your roster and fields them.
enlistment.retainedDescription: Re-enlist fields this exact companion, keeping their equipment, experience and current condition.
enlistment.success: Companion enlisted and fielded. Claim {{quest}} separately in your quest journal.

anyaTrades.title: Anya's Resource Trades
anyaTrades.description: After claiming Anya’s Gift, choose a fixed unique. Each is available once per character across all difficulties. Purchases stay unequipped and require a free backpack slot.
anyaTrades.locked: Complete Prison of Ice, actually thaw Anya, speak with her here, then Claim Anya’s Gift in Quests to unlock these trades.
anyaTrades.soldOut: Sold out for this character. Selling or salvaging the item does not restore stock.
anyaTrades.backpackFull: Make one free backpack slot before trading.
anyaTrades.unavailable: This trade is unavailable in the current character, save or town state.
anyaTrades.confirmation: Receive {{name}} for {{scrap}} Scrap and {{shards}} Rune Shards. This spends this item’s only stock. The item stays unequipped; equipping requires level {{level}}.
anyaTrades.success: Trade complete. Your unique is in your backpack; its stock is now sold out.
anyaTrades.failed: The trade could not finish. Check your resources and stock before retrying.
anyaTrades.staleSelection: Your selection is no longer current. Review the offer and choose it again.
anyaTrades.restorationFailed: The trade could not be restored safely. Resolve the save recovery warning before trying again.
anyaTrades.busy: Another action is still finishing. Try again when it completes.
